Caveat, a tooling bug rather than a reason to reject: canon.mjs templates the name to ^monthly on the .+?rd$, so the 'rd' suffix is kept and the replay only matches on the 3rd or 23rd. On other days it fails loudly with no element matched; it does not silently audit the wrong screen. The fix is to template ordinal suffixes (st/nd/rd/th) and probably weekday names in nameTemplate.
